channel.description: Latest articles from The College Fix (thecollegefix.com)

item.title: UT Austin to merge gender, African, Latina/Latino studies departments
item.description: UT Austin is merging several departments, including women’s, gender, and African studies. President Jim Davis cited factors like academic mission and resource allocation. However, one professor condemned the move as an "authoritarian takeover."

item.title: U. Washington professor examines ice (not ICE) through lens of colonialism and race
item.description: Jen Rose Smith, a geography professor at the University of Washington, explores the interplay of colonialism, race, and indigeneity in her new book, "Ice Geographies." Through critical analysis, she examines ice as a racialized space, integrating themes from Native, Black, and ethnic studies into her discourse on the politics surrounding ice and its cultural representations.

item.title: Oklahoma State professor: Bad Bunny a sensation due to ‘gentrifying’ black music
item.description: The selection of Bad Bunny for Super Bowl 60's halftime show sparked controversy, in part from Oklahoma State's Lawrence Ware, who argues Bunny has appropriated reggaetón from its Black origins. Ware claims this musical gentrification makes the genre more marketable to a predominantly white audience, sidelining its Black pioneers and heritage.

item.title: Teachers ousted, disciplined over pro-ICE social media comments
item.description: Teachers faced backlash for pro-ICE social media comments, leading to resignations and administrative leave. In West Chicago, a PE teacher resigned after support for ICE sparked community protests, while in Watsonville, a special ed teacher's similar remarks prompted calls for her dismissal.

item.title: Harvard ‘ecofascism’ professor also taught course on ‘aquatic, atmospheric life of Blackness’
item.description: Nikki Hoskins, a Harvard Divinity School professor, teaches courses linking ecofascism and intersectionality with Blackness, examining how religious and racial narratives shape environmental ideologies. Her curriculum addresses the dangers of ecofascism while promoting alternative ecologies through Black perspectives, emphasizing the deep historical roots of contemporary climate rhetoric and advocating for justice in environmental relationships.

item.title: Oldest Catholic univ.’s student paper: School should stop hosting pro-life conference
item.description: Georgetown University's student paper, The Hoya, urges the university to stop hosting the Cardinal O’Connor Conference on Life, citing its divisive anti-LGBTQ+ stance and alleged harmful ideology. The editorial argues this contradicts the school's commitment to "cura personalis" and suggests reforms to better align the conference with Jesuit values, promoting inclusivity and diverse viewpoints.

item.title: University of Florida to stop ‘gender-affirming care’ for students
item.description: University of Florida will no longer help transgender students look like the opposite sex.

item.title: Boston U. teaching hospital glossary says ‘biology’ doesn’t define sex
item.description: Glossary states sex is not fixed, binary The primary teaching hospital of Boston University’s medical school, recently updated its “Glossary for Culture Transformation” to include dozens of ideologically loaded terms, a medical advocacy group found. item.title: UCLA staff ‘talk to’ lonely Native American museum pieces at tribe’s request
item.description: UCLA staff are visiting and 'talk[ing] to' Native American artifacts in its museum collection, per tribal request.

item.title: Free speech group defends U. Illinois College Republicans amid uproar over ICE post
item.description: Student group faced backlash for a graphic resembling recent fatal shooting of Alex Pretti.
